character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Pixel art game asset sprite, full-body character portrait of Dr. Malphas modular carnage boss, front-facing top-down perspective. Pale, cadaverous human torso mounted at the center of a circular mechanical chassis, with four articulated robotic arms extending outward armed with giant surgical pincers and laser scalpels. Back entwined with exposed pulsing organic flesh strings and tangled fiber-optic cables acting as tentacles. Hypertrophic augmented reality goggles welded directly to the skull, dripping a small stream of viscous green chemical fluid. 90s retro anime aesthetic, clean sharp pixel lines, gritty cyberpunk color palette, transparent background, isolated sprite, NO background elements, NO walls, NO ground.
